frontend_code_fingerprints.scope: Complete served code block; not container digest attestation.

native_checks: Restored document and new copy have exactly the earlier rich native tabs, including bold text and 2x2 table.
Named version persists; precisely one copy created.
Protected document, its native history and complete file metadata are exactly unchanged.
Source permissions, ownership, parents, sharing and trash state are unchanged; unrelated captured collections unchanged.
browser_checks: Desktop rich preview, name version and restore confirmation.
390px named-only filtering, historical Evidence tab selection and in-page copy dialog.
Copied document opens and retains rich content after reload; mobile page width remains 390px.
limits: This is a bounded manual hosted flow, not full provider parity or an additional scored candidate rollout.
Successful exact-commit deployment plus served block fingerprints are not per-container digest attestation.
No complete pixel comparison or physical-touch/mobile device audit.
